subject: QBR: pipeline walkthrough + account packet prep
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR: pipeline walkthrough + account packet prep

Team — kicking off the QBR packet prep thread. We need a short, account-by-account packet for each major deal in the runway and a consolidated forecast matrix for the leadership readout on Thu. Quick ask list below: 

1) Owners: please fill the attached "QBR-playbook-template.xlsx" for your accounts by EOD Wed (12/2). One row per account; include RAG risk, closing milestone, expected ARR, and next blockers.
2) Forecast: I need a consolidated forecast table (sheet 2 in the template) with: commit, upside, and confidence band. We will roll this up for the exec deck.
3) OKR check-in: flag any accounts with OKR alignment implications (e.g., large new logos that touch infra OKR).
4) Attachments: add any external artifacts to the shared drive link below; reference HubSpot record id in the template.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e_QBR_PACKETS
Deadline: Wed 12/2 5pm PT for owner inputs; Thu 12/3 9am PT final consolidated table to execs.

I'll run a 30-minute walkthrough Wed 10am PT to go through the consolidated numbers and surface any blind spots. If you can't make the walkthrough, leave comments in the sheet and ping me.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

- Acme (renewal): finance is asking for an updated SOW; Scott R's PO stage is in procurement.

I'll complete the template for my accounts by EOD Wed. If anyone wants the raw export earlier, ping me and I'll send.

— Marissa

Sergio / team — quick flag on Zephyr. I reviewed Marissa's notes and the HS record (HS-54621). Their close plan currently lists a commercial decision on 12/15; procurement timeline from Lisa's side usually adds 2–3 weeks. Please treat the current ACV as 'upside' not 'commit' unless we have an executed SOW or DocuSign link.

Action items for Zephyr:
- Marissa: capture the latest payment terms and any legal exceptions in the template.
- Marissa + Markus: run a discrete risk-tag (Legal / Billing / Integration) and place a confidence percentage (0–100) in the confidence column.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/ACME-2091 (I know it's for Acme, but similar flow applies for Zephyr once DocuSign packet is started.)

I uploaded Zephyr-forecast-notes.pdf to the Drive.

— Laura

Hi all — thanks for the heads up. Quick clarity from Zephyr side:
- We are committed to a pilot go-live by 12/20. Commercial approval is on track for mid-December but procurement requires a final SOW and internal budget sign-off.
- Risk: integration QA shows two API gaps; engineering estimates 1.5–2 weeks to remediate. That pushes possible full production ramp into January unless we scope a phased rollout.

I can share the internal procurement timeline if helpful — looping procurement@betacloud.com for visibility on the PO process.

Best,
Lisa Chen
Head of Product, Zephyr Analytics

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Great thread — summary and next steps: 

Summary:
- Zephyr: current status = commercial-side mid-Dec; procurement likely trailing 2–3 weeks. Integration risk may push production to Jan. Treat as UP-SIDE for QBR unless DocuSign/SOW received before EOD Wed.
- Acme: need SOW + updated pricing table (Laura to confirm finance exceptions).

Immediate actions (owners):
- Marissa: finalize the template rows for your accounts and upload the CSV mapping. (Due Wed 12/2 5pm PT)
- Laura: add risk-tags + confidence percentages for all enterprise deals in your sheet. (Due Wed 12/2 5pm PT)
- Markus: I'll need your top 6 account one-pagers for the walkthrough (short bullets: milestone, ask, blocker). Drop in Drive under /top-6/ before Wed COB.
- Tessa: please consolidate OKR impact notes for any new-logo deals that affect infra or security OKRs.

I'll consolidate everything after COB Wed and share a single table for the 10am Wed walkthrough. If any of the external procurement contacts are open to a 15-minute sync, loop them into the 10am slot and I'll coordinate.

Attachments referenced: QBR-playbook-template.xlsx, account-summaries-map.csv, Zephyr-forecast-notes.pdf

Thanks — let's keep this tight.

— Sergio
